papers.title: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM
papers.summary: RGB-D 영상으로 3D Gaussian 지도를 갱신하고 카메라를 추적하며, silhouette mask로 관측된 영역과 새로 추가할 영역을 구분한다.
papers.core: silhouette mask가 tracking에 쓸 픽셀과 지도를 확장할 영역을 어떻게 정하는지 작은 예로 보여주세요.

papers.title: Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.summary: 3D Gaussian 표현을 이용한 렌더링과 직접 최적화를 카메라 tracking 및 mapping에 함께 사용한다.
papers.core: 카메라 pose를 바꿨을 때 렌더링된 영상과 잔차가 어떻게 바뀌는지, monocular 입력에서 어떤 모호성이 남는지 설명해 보세요.

papers.title: GS-SLAM: Dense Visual SLAM with 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: 3D Gaussian 지도를 확장·정리하고, coarse-to-fine pose 추정에서 신뢰할 수 있는 Gaussian을 선택한다.
papers.core: 지도에 Gaussian을 추가하거나 제거하는 조건과 pose 추정에 사용할 Gaussian을 고르는 과정을 구분해 설명해 보세요.

papers.title: Photo-SLAM: Real-time Simultaneous Localization and Photorealistic Mapping for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras
papers.summary: 기하 특징을 이용한 localization과 photometric 표현 학습을 결합하고, Gaussian pyramid 학습으로 지도의 영상 세부 정보를 점진적으로 표현한다.
papers.core: localization과 photorealistic mapping에 쓰는 정보를 나누어 그리고, pyramid 학습이 어떤 영상 정보를 단계적으로 학습하는지 설명해 보세요.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.summary: SfM으로 얻은 희소 점에서 출발해 Gaussian의 위치·공분산·appearance를 최적화하고, 밀도 조절과 splatting으로 새로운 시점의 영상을 렌더링한다.
papers.core: 공분산이 화면에 투영되는 모양을 바꾸는 과정과, densification이 필요한 이유를 그림으로 설명해 보세요.

papers.title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
papers.summary: 여러 영상에서 카메라 파라미터, point map, depth map, 3D point track을 함께 예측하는 feed-forward Transformer를 제안한다.
papers.core: 영상 간 attention과 여러 출력 head가 공통 3D 기하를 학습하는 방식, 예측 결과와 bundle adjustment의 역할을 설명한다.

papers.title: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
papers.summary: DUSt3R의 point map 예측에 local feature head와 matching loss를 추가해 영상 대응점 추정을 3D 재구성과 연결한다.
papers.core: Point map 회귀와 feature matching의 관계, reciprocal matching이 대응점을 찾는 절차를 설명한다.

papers.title: MASt3R-SLAM: Real-Time Dense SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
papers.summary: MASt3R의 두 영상 3D prior를 point map matching, 카메라 추적, 지도 융합, loop closure와 전역 최적화에 사용하는 단안 dense SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: Point map을 ray로 바꾸는 central camera model과 angular matching, 전역 최적화가 프레임 간 일관성을 만드는 과정을 설명한다.

papers.title: PINGS: Gaussian Splatting Meets Distance Fields within a Point-Based Implicit Neural Map
papers.summary: Point-based implicit neural map 안에서 signed distance field와 Gaussian radiance field를 결합하는 LiDAR-visual SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: 거리장과 radiance field 사이의 기하 일관성 제약이 LiDAR와 영상 정보를 연결하는 원리를 설명한다.

papers.title: DG-SLAM: Robust Dynamic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Hybrid Pose Optimization
papers.summary: 동적 장면에서 motion mask, Gaussian 관리와 hybrid camera tracking을 결합하는 Gaussian SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: 동적 물체가 photometric·geometric 잔차에 미치는 영향과 motion mask 및 pose optimization의 연결을 설명한다.

papers.title: OpenVO: Open-World Visual Odometry with Temporal Dynamics Awareness
papers.summary: 촬영 간격과 카메라 보정 정보가 일정하지 않은 단안 주행 영상에서 시간 정보와 3D prior를 활용해 ego-motion을 추정한다.
papers.core: 두 프레임 pose regression에 시간 간격을 반영하는 이유와 uncalibrated 입력에서 3D prior가 제공하는 정보를 설명한다.

papers.title: AERGS-SLAM: Auto-Exposure-Robust Stereo 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.summary: 자동 노출 변화가 있는 stereo 영상에서 조명 변화에 대응하는 localization과 exposure model을 이용한 Gaussian mapping을 분리해 구성한다.
papers.core: 노출 변화가 photometric consistency를 깨는 조건과 camera exposure network가 rendering 과정에 들어가는 위치를 설명한다.

papers.title: VGGT-SLAM 2.0: Real-time Dense Feed-forward Scene Reconstruction
papers.summary: VGGT submap 정합을 위한 factor graph를 재설계하고 VGGT attention을 loop closure 검증에 활용하는 RGB SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: 원래 VGGT-SLAM의 projective ambiguity와 planar degeneracy를 구분하고 새 factor graph의 제약 및 attention 기반 검증을 설명한다.

papers.title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
papers.summary: Voxel마다 방향을 가진 height image로 표면을 표현하고 기하 정보가 풍부한 영역을 골라 LiDAR-inertial registration에 사용한다.
papers.core: 단순한 기하 환경에서 registration이 약해지는 이유와 voxel height image 및 map-informed sampling이 사용하는 정보를 설명한다.

papers.title: AnyFeature-VSLAM: Automating the Usage of Any Feature into Visual SLAM
papers.summary: ORB-SLAM2를 바탕으로 다양한 keypoint와 descriptor를 사용할 때 필요한 feature 관련 파라미터 조정을 자동화한다.
papers.core: Feature 종류에 따라 바뀌는 matching 기준과 SLAM 파라미터를 짚고 자동 조정 절차를 설명한다.

papers.title: WildGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments
papers.summary: DINOv2 feature에서 예측한 uncertainty map을 tracking과 Gaussian map 최적화에 사용해 동적 장면의 단안 SLAM을 수행한다.
papers.core: Pixel별 uncertainty가 dense bundle adjustment와 Gaussian mapping의 잔차에 반영되는 과정을 설명한다.

papers.title: VGGT-SLAM: Dense RGB SLAM Optimized on the SL(4) Manifold
papers.summary: Uncalibrated 단안 영상으로 만든 VGGT submap을 SL(4) 위의 최적화로 정합하고 loop closure를 반영한다.
papers.core: Similarity transform으로 표현되지 않는 projective reconstruction ambiguity와 15자유도 submap 정합의 필요 조건을 설명한다.

papers.title: SLAM-Former: Putting SLAM into One Transformer
papers.summary: 하나의 Transformer에서 단안 영상의 점진적 tracking·mapping과 전역 refinement를 교대로 수행하는 SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: Frontend의 순차 처리와 backend의 전역 보정이 어떤 상태를 주고받으며 지도 일관성을 유지하는지 설명한다.

papers.title: Learning to Filter Outlier Edges in Global SfM
papers.summary: Pose graph를 line graph로 바꾸고 Transformer로 부정확한 relative translation edge를 찾아 translation averaging 전에 제거한다.
papers.core: Pose graph의 edge가 line graph의 node로 바뀌는 과정과 outlier filtering이 translation averaging에 미치는 영향을 설명한다.

papers.title: CG-SLAM: Efficient Dense RGB-D SLAM in a Consistent Uncertainty-aware 3D Gaussian Field
papers.summary: 기하 일관성과 depth uncertainty를 고려한 3D Gaussian field를 사용해 RGB-D tracking과 mapping을 수행한다.
papers.core: Gaussian anisotropy와 surface 정합의 관계, depth uncertainty에 따른 primitive 선택을 설명한다.

papers.title: SGS-SLAM: Semantic Gaussian Splatting For Neural Dense SLAM
papers.summary: Appearance, geometry, semantic feature를 함께 최적화하고 semantic 정보로 keyframe을 선택하는 Gaussian SLAM을 제안한다.
papers.core: Color·depth loss에 semantic feature loss를 더하는 목적과 semantic-guided keyframe 선택 과정을 설명한다.

papers.title: Fast3R: Towards 3D Reconstruction of 1000+ Images in One Forward Pass
papers.summary: Predicts aligned 3D point maps from many images in a single forward pass, replacing pairwise reconstruction and iterative global alignment.

papers.title: Structure-from-Motion with a Non-Parametric Camera Model
papers.summary: Performs structure from motion with a non-parametric camera model that adapts to available calibration constraints and varied camera optics.

papers.title: Reloc3r: Large-Scale Training of Relative Camera Pose Regression for Generalizable, Fast, and Accurate Visual Localization
papers.summary: Combines learned relative camera pose regression with motion averaging to localize images across previously unseen scenes.

papers.title: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images with Optimal Training Supervision
papers.summary: Estimates an affine-invariant 3D point map from a single image using training objectives that balance global geometry and local detail.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

papers.title: FLARE: Feed-forward Geometry, Appearance and Camera Estimation from Uncalibrated Sparse Views
papers.summary: Uses a cascaded feed-forward model to estimate cameras, scene geometry, and appearance from sparse uncalibrated images.

papers.title: MUSt3R: Multi-view Network for Stereo 3D Reconstruction
papers.summary: Extends stereo point-map prediction to multiple views using a symmetric architecture and a memory mechanism for shared-frame 3D reconstruction.

papers.title: Pow3R: Empowering Unconstrained 3D Reconstruction with Camera and Scene Priors
papers.summary: Conditions learned 3D reconstruction on available camera intrinsics, relative poses, and depth priors while retaining support for unconstrained inputs.

papers.title: Light3R-SfM: Towards Feed-forward Structure-from-Motion
papers.summary: Aligns multi-view geometry in latent space with attention and a sparse view graph to enable feed-forward structure from motion.

papers.title: Dense-SfM: Structure from Motion with Dense Consistent Matching
papers.summary: Builds structure from motion around dense correspondences, extending tracks and refining matches to improve consistency across views.

papers.title: DiffusionSfM: Predicting Structure and Motion via Ray Origin and Endpoint Diffusion
papers.summary: Uses diffusion to predict camera ray origins and endpoints in a shared frame, jointly recovering camera motion and scene structure.

papers.title: MV-DUSt3R+: Single-Stage Scene Reconstruction from Sparse Views In 2 Seconds
papers.summary: Fuses sparse uncalibrated images through multi-view and cross-reference decoding to predict scene geometry and Gaussian representations in one stage.

papers.title: ZeroVO: Visual Odometry with Minimal Assumptions
papers.summary: Combines geometry-aware visual learning and language-derived priors for visual odometry without requiring camera calibration at inference.

papers.title: DepthSplat: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth
papers.summary: Connects multi-view depth estimation with Gaussian prediction, using pretrained monocular features and rendering supervision to support both tasks.

papers.title: Video Depth Anything: Consistent Depth Estimation for Super-Long Videos
papers.summary: Combines a spatiotemporal depth model, temporal training losses, and keyframe-based inference to estimate consistent depth over long videos.

papers.title: FoundationStereo: Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
papers.summary: Combines synthetic stereo training, monocular foundation features, and long-range cost-volume reasoning for stereo depth estimation in unseen domains.

papers.title: GaussianWorld: Gaussian World Model for Streaming 3D Occupancy Prediction
papers.summary: Updates a Gaussian scene representation through ego-motion alignment, dynamic motion modeling, and scene completion for streaming 3D occupancy prediction.

papers.title: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction
papers.summary: Represents geometry through probabilistic Gaussian superposition and semantics through Gaussian mixtures for efficient 3D occupancy prediction.

papers.title: Dr. Splat: Directly Referring 3D Gaussian Splatting via Direct Language Embedding Registration
papers.summary: Registers language embeddings directly onto 3D Gaussians and compresses them for text-driven querying of reconstructed scenes.

papers.title: MAGiC-SLAM: Multi-Agent Gaussian Globally Consistent  SLAM
papers.summary: Combines Gaussian mapping across multiple agents with map merging and loop closure to maintain globally consistent camera trajectories and scene maps.

papers.title: ActiveGAMER: Active GAussian Mapping through Efficient Rendering
papers.summary: Uses information gain estimated through Gaussian rendering to choose camera viewpoints for active scene reconstruction.

papers.title: InstanceGaussian: Appearance-Semantic Joint Gaussian Representation for 3D Instance-Level Perception
papers.summary: Jointly learns Gaussian appearance and semantic features, then aggregates them into instances for 3D scene perception.

papers.title: VGGSfM: Visual Geometry Grounded Deep Structure From Motion
papers.summary: Combines learned feature tracking, camera estimation, and differentiable bundle adjustment in an end-to-end trainable structure-from-motion pipeline.

papers.title: Detector-Free Structure from Motion
papers.summary: Initializes structure from motion from quantized detector-free correspondences, then refines feature tracks and geometry across multiple views.
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

papers.title: XFeat: Accelerated Features for Lightweight Image Matching
papers.summary: Extracts sparse and semi-dense local image features with a lightweight network and refines matches for efficient image correspondence estimation.

papers.title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data
papers.summary: Learns monocular depth from large collections of automatically labeled images with strong augmentation and semantic guidance from pretrained visual features.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

papers.title: pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction
papers.summary: Predicts 3D Gaussians from an image pair by differentiably sampling their locations from learned depth distributions for generalizable view synthesis.

papers.title: SuGaR: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Mesh Reconstruction and High-Quality Mesh Rendering
papers.summary: Regularizes Gaussians to align with surfaces, enabling mesh extraction and optional joint refinement of the mesh and Gaussian representation.

papers.title: Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
papers.summary: Organizes Gaussians around spatial anchors and predicts their attributes from viewing conditions for adaptive scene rendering.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

papers.title: LangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting
papers.summary: Stores compressed language features on 3D Gaussians and uses hierarchical semantic supervision to enable open-vocabulary scene queries.

papers.title: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships
papers.summary: Aligns 3D scene-graph features with vision-language representations to support open-vocabulary object queries and flexible relationship descriptions.

papers.title: SNI-SLAM: Semantic Neural Implicit SLAM
papers.summary: Fuses appearance, geometry, and semantic features through cross-attention in a neural implicit representation for semantic RGB-D SLAM.
affiliations: China University of Mining and Technology

papers.title: Loopy-SLAM: Dense Neural SLAM with Loop Closures
papers.summary: Builds neural point-cloud submaps and uses place recognition, loop closure, and pose-graph optimization to correct accumulated mapping drift.

papers.title: LEAP-VO: Long-term Effective Any Point Tracking for Visual Odometry
papers.summary: Uses long-term point tracking with temporal uncertainty estimation as the front end of visual odometry in occluded and dynamic scenes.
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

papers.title: Optimal Transport Aggregation for Visual Place Recognition
papers.summary: Aggregates local features through optimal transport, selectively discarding uninformative features to form global descriptors for visual place recognition.

papers.title: CricaVPR: Cross-image Correlation-aware Representation Learning for Visual Place Recognition
papers.summary: Learns place descriptors using cross-image correlations and multi-scale adaptation of pretrained visual features to account for viewpoint and appearance changes.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

papers.title: SG-PGM: Partial Graph Matching Network with Semantic Geometric Fusion for 3D Scene Graph Alignment and Its Downstream Tasks
papers.summary: Fuses semantic and geometric features to partially match 3D scene graphs and guide point-cloud registration in overlapping scene regions.
affiliations: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence

papers.title: Point Transformer V3: Simpler Faster Stronger
papers.summary: Uses serialized point-cloud neighborhoods to scale transformer processing efficiently for 3D representation learning and downstream perception tasks.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

papers.title: Co-SLAM: Joint Coordinate and Sparse Parametric Encodings for Neural Real-Time SLAM
papers.summary: Combines coordinate and sparse parametric encodings with global keyframe bundle adjustment for RGB-D camera tracking and neural surface mapping.

papers.title: ESLAM: Efficient Dense SLAM System Based on Hybrid Representation of Signed Distance Fields
papers.summary: Represents scene geometry and color with multi-scale feature planes and shallow decoders for joint RGB-D camera tracking and dense reconstruction.

papers.title: vMAP: Vectorised Object Mapping for Neural Field SLAM
papers.summary: Maps detected objects as separate neural fields and optimizes them with vectorized training during object-level RGB-D SLAM.

papers.title: Neuralangelo: High-Fidelity Neural Surface Reconstruction
papers.summary: Combines multi-resolution hash grids, numerical gradients, and coarse-to-fine optimization to reconstruct detailed surfaces from multi-view RGB images.

papers.title: OpenScene: 3D Scene Understanding With Open Vocabularies
papers.summary: Embeds 3D scene points in a shared image-text feature space, enabling open-vocabulary semantic queries without labeled 3D training data.
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

papers.title: OrienterNet: Visual Localization in 2D Public Maps With Neural Matching
papers.summary: Matches a learned bird's-eye-view representation of a single image against a public 2D map to estimate camera pose probabilistically.

papers.title: R2Former: Unified Retrieval and Reranking Transformer for Place Recognition
papers.summary: Uses a transformer to combine image retrieval and candidate reranking through feature correlations, attention, and spatial information for place recognition.

papers.title: BUFFER: Balancing Accuracy, Efficiency, and Generalizability in Point Cloud Registration
papers.summary: Combines pointwise keypoints and orientations, patch descriptors, and correspondence filtering to balance accuracy and efficiency in point-cloud registration.

papers.title: PVO: Panoptic Visual Odometry
papers.summary: Jointly refines panoptic segmentation and visual odometry, using semantic masks to handle motion and geometry to propagate segmentation across frames.

papers.title: LightGlue: Local Feature Matching at Light Speed
papers.summary: Matches local image features with an attention-based network that adapts its computational effort to the difficulty of each image pair.

papers.title: GlueStick: Robust Image Matching by Sticking Points and Lines Together
papers.summary: Matches points and line segments jointly by representing images as wireframes and exploiting their connectivity with a graph neural network.

papers.title: Point-SLAM: Dense Neural Point Cloud-based SLAM
papers.summary: Anchors neural features to an adaptive point cloud and uses rendering losses for camera tracking and dense RGB-D scene reconstruction.

papers.title: GO-SLAM: Global Optimization for Consistent 3D Instant Reconstruction
papers.summary: Combines neural implicit reconstruction with loop closure and global bundle adjustment to jointly maintain consistent camera poses and scene geometry.

papers.title: Zip-NeRF: Anti-Aliased Grid-Based Neural Radiance Fields
papers.summary: Combines grid-based neural radiance fields with scale-aware sampling and anti-aliasing to render views with reduced sampling artifacts.

papers.title: EigenPlaces: Training Viewpoint Robust Models for Visual Place Recognition
papers.summary: Groups training images by place and viewing direction to learn global descriptors that support place recognition across viewpoint changes.

papers.title: SGAligner: 3D Scene Alignment with Scene Graphs
papers.summary: Learns joint multimodal embeddings to align 3D scene graphs under partial overlap and scene changes, supporting geometric scene registration.

papers.title: NeRF-LOAM: Neural Implicit Representation for Large-Scale Incremental LiDAR Odometry and Mapping
papers.summary: Uses a neural signed-distance representation for incremental LiDAR odometry and mapping, including separate treatment of ground and non-ground geometry.

papers.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.summary: Separates static and dynamic Gaussians and learns time-dependent deformations with optical-flow constraints for RGB-D SLAM in changing scenes.

papers.title: Splat-LOAM: Gaussian Splatting LiDAR Odometry and Mapping
papers.summary: Uses spherical projection to refine a Gaussian scene representation from LiDAR measurements for joint odometry and mapping.

papers.title: DyGS-SLAM: Real-Time Accurate Localization and Gaussian Reconstruction for Dynamic Scenes
papers.summary: Combines geometric, appearance, and semantic cues to identify dynamic content and build a Gaussian map of the static background during SLAM.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

papers.title: ToF-Splatting: Dense SLAM using Sparse Time-of-Flight Depth and Multi-Frame Integration
papers.summary: Combines sparse time-of-flight depth with RGB observations and multi-frame geometry to support dense Gaussian mapping and camera tracking.

papers.title: FROSS: Faster-Than-Real-Time Online 3D Semantic Scene Graph Generation from RGB-D Images
papers.summary: Lifts 2D scene graphs into a 3D Gaussian object representation to incrementally build semantic scene graphs from RGB-D observations.
